messages:
maria: Quick design check — thinking about switching roles matrix from full table to 'role chips' for teams under 20. Pros: cleaner, faster scan. Cons: discoverability of permissions. Thoughts?

sam: I like chips for density. Concern: keyboard focus order + tooltip for perms. We should avoid hover-only info. @kelly can you weigh in on a11y?

kelly: Hover-only is no-go. Need focusable elements and aria-describedby on the chip. Suggest: open perms via enter/space and include `role=button` on chips. Also color contrast for state changes.

raj: From an eng POV: chips reduce DOM complexity but we still need server-side pagination for big orgs. Also we need an API to fetch role details lazily. Example payload: 
```
GET /orgs/:id/roles?expand=permission_summary
```

oliver: Invite flow copy: current 'Give access' vs 'Invite member' inconsistency. Propose we standardize to 'Invite and assign role' — clearer but long. Maybe 'Invite & assign'?

sam: Prefer concise: 'Invite & assign' — add tooltip 'You can change this later' for reassurance. Also SSO toggle label: 'Require SSO for this org' vs 'Enforce SSO' — which is clearer?

kelly: Use 'Require SSO' — 'enforce' implies punitive. For screen readers, read out toggle state: 'SSO required: on/off'.

maria: @raj can we add an audit log 'jump to' link when changing a role in the UI? PMs asked for breadcrumbs to the audit entry. Sketch: small link 'view audit event' after save.

raj: Can do. We'll record audit_event_id in response: 
```
POST /orgs/:id/roles/:role_id/assign -> { audit_event_id: 98765 }
```
Front-end can redirect to /audit?event=98765

uxbot: Design note: make sure the 'view audit event' link opens in the right context (preserve filters) and has aria-label='Open audit event in activity log'.

oliver: Agree. One more nit: when SSO is enforced, invite modal should gray out password fields and explain 'accounts will be created on first SSO login'. Copy suggestion: 'Accounts are provisioned on first SSO sign-in.'

maria: Nice. OK action items: sam to update chips prototype with keyboard behavior, raj to stub API, kelly to write a11y checklist, oliver to finalize copy. I'll loop in legal if SSO copy needs compliance. :thumbsup:
